page_title: BRE 0-1 AST | Brentford v Aston Villa 08/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van den Berg S. Knee Injury

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) has tested the patience of referee Jarred Gillett and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+4' A pass from Kevin Schade (Brentford) is intercepted by Robin Olsen and the move breaks down.
90+4' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) replacing Morgan Rogers.
90+3' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
90+3' The game has come to an end for Kristoffer Ajer. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ji-Soo Kim (Brentford).
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Robin Olsen intercepts the ball.
88' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
87' A cross into the box from Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) is cleared.
85' Jarred Gillett interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Mathias Jensen (Brentford).
84' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) smashes the ball with a volley from the edge of the box, but his poor attempt goes miles wide of the left post.
83' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

83' That didn't go as planned. Kevin Schade (Brentford) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the left side of the goal was too weak to get past Robin Olsen, who easily kept it out.
82' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post.
81' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
81' Aston Villa take a short corner kick.
80' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
78' Kevin Schade (Brentford) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vitaly Janelt leaves the pitch and Mathias Jensen (Brentford) comes on.
75' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is penalised for a foul. Jarred Gillett had a clear view and blows his whistle.
73' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
72' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) accepts a sweet pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot towards the goal, but he only hits the left post! What an unlucky moment for him.
70' Kevin Schade (Brentford) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
68' We are about to witness a subsitution. Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) for Jacob Ramsey.
67' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) receives a yellow card!
66' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Kevin Schade (Brentford), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
64' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
61' Substitution. Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) on for John McGinn.
60' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) sends a cross into the box, but Robin Olsen comes off his line to gather the ball.
59' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
57' Kevin Schade (Brentford) is penalised for holding. Jarred Gillett signals a set piece.
54' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target.
54' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
53' The goal by Aston Villa won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
52' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Aston Villa players aren’t happy.
50' And it's a goal! Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) slips the ball past the goalkeeper.
49' 0 - 1 Goal! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:1.
49' Kevin Schade (Brentford) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Unai Emery gives a chance to Matty Cash and Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' A cross is whipped into the box by Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) and Kevin Schade controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
42' John McGinn (Aston Villa) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jarred Gillett didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
42' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) unleashes a powerful shot from the free kick but it only hits the defensive wall.
40' Aston Villa are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
40' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa). Jarred Gillett saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
40' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
36' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Yoane Wissa (Brentford) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
35' One of the players from Aston Villa times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
35' Aston Villa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
34' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) takes the corner but it's cleared.
33' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Lucas Digne (Aston Villa).
32' Kevin Schade (Brentford) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
31' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Robin Olsen as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
30' An attempted cross from Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is cleared.
27' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jarred Gillett blows for a foul.
25' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
23' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
21' A lofted cross from Tyrone Mings (Aston Villa) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
20' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) plays a one-two with Jacob Ramsey, but the move breaks down.
16' Tyrone Mings (Aston Villa) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards goal, but Mark Flekken makes a magnificent save!
15' Axel Disasi (Aston Villa) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
14' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Mark Flekken leaps to intercept the corner kick from Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa).
12' Aston Villa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
12' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
10' The defender did brilliantly to block the long-range effort from Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa).
9' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
7' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
5' It looks like John McGinn (Aston Villa) saw red with that tackle. Jarred Gillett won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
4' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Aston Villa will take the kick-off.
Jarred Gillett is the one to supervise the game today.
